news.title: Two first-half goals seal the deal for Pennsauken Tech boys soccer over Edison Magnet
news.excerpt: Pennsauken Tech (15-6), which has won two of its last three games, advanced to the final and will face 12th-seeded Morris Tech at East Brunswick Magnet in East Brunswick on Monday, Oct. 26.

news.title: 16th-seed Cumberland boys soccer upends top seed in 1st round of South Jersey Coaches Cup
news.excerpt: Cumberland (13-4-1) advanced to the quarterfinals and will visit Saturday’s winner between ninth-seeded Shawnee at eighth-seeded Northern Burlington on Monday, Oct. 26.

news.title: Second half heroics by senior duo leads Bordentown boys soccer over No. 19 Cherokee
news.excerpt: Bordentown (12-3-2) advanced to the quarterfinals and will play Saturday’s winner between 13th-seeded Kingsway at fourth-seeded Haddonfield on Monday, Oct. 26.

news.title: Senior’s goal snaps Cherry Hill West girls soccer’s 11-game winless run
news.excerpt: The Lions got back into the W column

Overtime goal lifts Sterling boys soccer over Rancocas Valley in SJCC first round
news.excerpt: Sterling (13-2-2), which has won two straight and is 3-1-1 in their last five games, advanced to the quarterfinals and will host sixth-seeded Cherry Hill East on Monday, Oct. 26.
